first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The man with a buzz cut leaning against the railing on the image-left, with a tall, slender build, wearing a dark zip-up jacket and dark trousers.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The man leaning against the railing on the image-right, wearing a dark close-fitting knit cap, a loose dark leather jacket, a light-colored turtleneck top, and light-colored trousers.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: The man passing through the nearer foreground from image-right to image-left, wearing a dark pom-pom hat, a thick coat with light-colored trim at the hem, and camouflage trousers.

entities.name: multistory buildings along the street
entities.identification: The group of multistory buildings on both sides of the road and in the central distance, with discernible rows of windows, horizontal floor lines, and a distant spire.

entities.name: city road
entities.identification: The road below and behind the area occupied by the foreground people, converging into the distance between the buildings on both sides.

entities.name: trees along the street
entities.identification: The group of trees on both sides of the background street and in front of the buildings, appearing as irregular dark-gray masses.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The light-gray sky visible between the buildings in the upper part of the image.

entities.name: group of road vehicles
entities.identification: The indistinct group of vehicles on the background road, identifiable by gray vehicle-body masses and bright spots from vehicle lights.

entities.name: dark metal railing
entities.identification: The dark top rail extending horizontally above the parapet and the spaced vertical posts.

entities.name: stone parapet
entities.identification: The horizontal parapet in the lower part of the image, with a wide dark band on top and a mottled light-gray wall surface below.
